title: Polo (Collared) — Front, Left-Breast Lockup
prompt: Premium product mockup of a folded/flat polo collared shirt in deep charcoal-black with a teal undertone (#0A1A1F), ribbed collar, photographed top-down on a soft neutral studio surface with gentle shadows. On the wearer's left breast: a small refined embroidered lockup — the Ongea Pesa orbital emblem (glowing cyan #22D3EE core into teal #0FB5A6, two soundwave arcs, a green-to-cyan orbit ring) above the 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark in clean geometric uppercase white. Directly below, a small endorser mark 'by NSAIT' in a subtle violet-to-blue gradient (#6D28D9 to #2563EB) with a tiny sparkle glyph. The chest emblem ~85mm wide, tasteful and corporate-premium. Realistic fabric texture, true embroidery feel, studio catalog quality. No other graphics.
negative_prompt: huge front print, busy patterns, purple emblem, microphone, dollar sign, wrinkled messy shirt, mannequin face, harsh neon, low-res, watermark, extra logos, distorted text

brand_lock.front: breast lockup only — Ongea emblem+wordmark, NSAIT below

notes: Also render a Mist-white (#E6F7F5) polo variant with ink wordmark. Keep it clean and corporate — this is the boardroom version of the merch.
